runtime: Headless ESM SI geometry and kinematics; browser parametric surface generator; optional OpenSCAD CLI reference generator

origins.locator: Original Mechanics profile fallback before shared adoption
BSD-2-Clause BOSL2 numerical surface adaptation; retained upstream source and licences

equations: Source generator; module in metres and angles in radians converted once to upstream millimetres/degrees
assumptions: Normal reference geometry, x=0; spur/helical mating helices have opposite hands
Bevel meshes share a pitch-cone apex; straight tooth uses spiral=0 and cutter_radius=0
Worm wheel is enveloping BOSL2 geometry; width solved from its own get_thickness function
Planetary ring uses a genuine internal-tooth cavity plus explicitly adopted rim thickness

variants.origin: Pinned BOSL2 numerical constructions with browser sampling and cap triangulation
equations: Involute lookup and clearance valley; normal-module helix; bevel-cone surfaces and backing; rack-generated worm; throated worm wheel; internal ring

limitations: Geometry and kinematics do not establish gear strength, bearing axial/radial capacity, efficiency, thermal limits or manufacturing tolerances.
OpenSCAD echo coordinates have six significant digits; nominal meshes are triangulated approximations.
Legacy analytical involute fallback retains a radial root transition, explicitly identified separately from BOSL2.
